title: A one-year term policy
caption: The policyholder dies within the year with probability 0.01, when £10,000 is paid at year end. The expected present value of the benefit is 10,000 × 0.01/1.05 ≈ £95.24: the single premium.
alt: A tree with a death branch of probability 1/100 and a survival branch of 99/100.
description: Dying within the year has probability q₆₀ = 0.01; surviving 0.99.
Only the death branch pays £10,000, at the end of the year.
